# Get URL Headers

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the headers at a certain URL.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getHeaders(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getHeaders(url: "https://jellycuts.com")
~~~~
